intent: To explain the company's business model, clarifying that while the majority of restaurants are franchised, the company retains ownership of the real estate.

units.meaning: The company owns and operates 15% of its restaurants.
accepted_routes: The company owns and operates 15% of its restaurants.
Company-operated stores are 15% of the total.
About one in seven restaurants is company-owned.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The red highlighted arc must stop at about 15% of the ring.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause introducing the restaurant mix, e.g. while the company only owns and operates...
units.reviewer_question: Is the 15% share mandatory, or is "a small minority" enough?

units.meaning: The remaining 85% of restaurants are franchised, as the FRANCHISED label on the ring states.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The ring carries the word FRANCHISED around the unhighlighted 85%.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause contrasting owned/operated versus franchised restaurants
units.reviewer_question: Is the derived 85% franchised share required to explain the restaurant mix?

units.meaning: The company retains ownership of the buildings and land beneath the restaurants, even when operations are franchised.
accepted_routes: The company owns the buildings and the land, even for franchised outlets.
Real estate stays with the company.
units.visual_evidence_rule: An icon or label must link the company to ownership of buildings/land.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause clarifying real estate ownership, e.g. it owns almost all of their buildings and the land beneath them
units.reviewer_question: Is the qualitative real-estate ownership claim required even though the table has no real-estate metric?

optional_valid: The 15% company-owned share can be described as about one in seven.
The ring labels the franchised part in words (FRANCHISED), so 85% is inferred from 100 - 15.
unsupported_to_avoid: Saying franchised restaurants are a minority; they are 85%.
Give a quantified real-estate ownership share: no real-estate values are in the table.
Causal claim that franchising causes the company to retain real estate.
notes: 旁白 owns and operates 15%，其余 85% 加盟；环上红弧 20% 是几何读数，按旁白取 15/85。环上弯排文字 FRANCHISED 指的是那 85%。
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
